sentences.en: Work hard, and your salary will be raised by degrees.
sentences.zh: 努力工作，你的工资会逐步提高。

sentences.en: The thermometer stood at three degrees below zero this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上温度计显示零下三度。

sentences.en: The governor compromised on the subject to a certain degree.
sentences.zh: 州长在该议题上做出了某种程度的妥协。
